description: This Kotlin source file defines a class `SmsManager` that manages sending and searching SMS/MMS messages on Android. It includes permission handling, message querying from the Android content providers, and message sending functionality, with support for JSON serialization of message data.

classes.name: SmsManager
classes.description: A class for managing SMS/MMS messaging heavily integrated with Android's content providers and permission system, supporting message sending, querying, and serialization.

methods.name: hasSmsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to send SMS messages.

methods.name: hasReadSmsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to read SMS messages.

methods.name: hasReadContactsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to read contacts.

methods.name: canSendSms
methods.description: Determines if the device can send SMS messages based on permission and telephony feature.

methods.name: canSearchSms
methods.description: Determines if the device can search SMS based on permission and telephony feature.

methods.name: canReadSms
methods.description: Determines if the device can read SMS, equivalent to canSearchSms.

methods.name: hasTelephonyFeature
methods.description: Checks if the device has telephony features.

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Attaches a permission requester to handle runtime permission requests.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Suspend function to send an SMS message given JSON parameters with 'to' and 'message'.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Suspend function to search SMS/MMS messages based on parameters provided in JSON.

methods.name: ensureSmsPermission
methods.description: Suspends until SMS permission is granted or returns false if not.

methods.name: ensureReadSmsPermission
methods.description: Suspends until read SMS permission is granted or returns false if not.

methods.name: ensureReadContactsPermission
methods.description: Suspends until read contacts permission is granted or returns false if not.

methods.name: okResult
methods.description: Constructs a successful SendResult object.

methods.name: errorResult
methods.description: Constructs a failed SendResult object with error message.

methods.name: queryOk
methods.description: Constructs a successful SearchResult object with messages and query metadata.

methods.name: queryError
methods.description: Constructs a failed SearchResult object with error message.

methods.name: getPhoneNumbersFromContactName
methods.description: Queries contacts database to get phone numbers matching a contact name.

methods.name: querySmsMessages
methods.description: Queries the device's SMS/MMS content provider for messages matching parameters.

methods.name: querySmsMmsMessagesByPhone
methods.description: Queries messages associated with a specific phone number, handling MMS and SMS.

methods.name: getMmsTextBody
methods.description: Extracts the text body from an MMS message part.

methods.name: getMmsMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for an MMS message such as message box type and read status.

methods.name: getMmsAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the address associated with an MMS message.
